REVISE

**Audit binding.** I audited PR #21 read-only at head `8ffca761866cf0e739b272177ff76bca748324d6` over base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`. The branch, upstream, remote branch, and fetched `refs/pull/21/head` all matched that head; the base matched `origin/main`; the diff is one commit and four files (340 insertions), `git diff --check` is clean, and there is no `canonical/`, `approval.json`, rejection, promotion, or canonical-game write.

**What reproduces.** With a browser user agent, the six official receipts `src-001/002/003/010/011/012` reproduced at HTTP 200 with the recorded final URL, MIME, bytes, and SHA-256. The rulebook is exactly 21,019,564 bytes, SHA-256 `7738ec6fd2dab30baa53cebc461e179746442650d1f0d12537f481495b7dfc69`, 48 pages, PDF 1.6, created/modified 2024-07-17. Bare curl receives the publisher's 406 response; that is an access-policy detail, not a missing source. Both reviews remain HTTP 200 and support the adjacent reception claims, although their live WordPress wrappers drifted in bytes/hash. All four Space-Biff images remain HTTP 200 JPEGs and are meaningful, distinct, source-linked base-game views: card ecosystem, Valley map, Ranger/aspect area, and full table state. Current dimensions are 604×296, 604×301, 604×325, and 604×308. Three WordPress resize responses drifted by a few bytes/hash and `src-008` reproduced exactly; the depicted semantics remain stable, and the report correctly makes no license claim or canonical copy.

**Accepted arithmetic and claim structure.** The component convention is accurate: `278 + 160 = 438` Ranger/Path cards; `37 + 24 + 4 + 17 + 4 + 4 + 12 = 102` separately listed gameplay cards; total `438 + 102 = 540` physical gameplay cards. Pages 32–33 require two copies of selected personality/background/specialty/outside-interest cards, so 540 is not an authoritative distinct-identity or rules-text denominator. Factual coverage must remain `UNKNOWN`/unscored; do not fabricate a percentage. All 8 research claims have adjacent Source/Evidence/Confidence fields, all 12 referenced IDs are declared, both independent reviews support their claims, and no rating/rank/weight claim leaks into the packet.

**Defect — the `1/6 (16.7%)` denominator is numerically rounded correctly but not yet a sound scoped denominator.** `round(100/6, 1) = 16.7`, but three of the six groups conflate current core/Lure authority with later expansions or historical first-printing material:

1. The public glossary is not merely an unknown set behind 22 letters. I retrieved all 22 category pages at HTTP 200 and enumerated 148 unique leaf entries (`A14 B3 C16 D10 E9 F7 G5 H3 I5 K2 L5 M10 N2 O3 P20 R13 S20 T11 U4 V2 W3 Y2`). The official 2025 update says this live glossary includes Legacy of the Ancestors, Stewards of the Valley, and Moments on the Path material. Therefore neither “22 categories” nor all 148 leaves is automatically the core/Lure denominator; Bathcat must retrieve and classify the leaf entries by product applicability.
2. The updates inventory does expose 16 card items and 35 Lure campaign-guide items, but the 16 card items are not all core/Lure: two are explicitly `LoA Mission Set Card 10 of 42` and `LoA Mission Set Card 17 of 42`. I retrieved all 16 item pages at HTTP 200. The remaining 14 are core/Lure-labelled items. The publisher also provides a retrievable two-page `Card_Errata_eng_web.pdf` (1,328,433 bytes; SHA-256 `395142fb44dc5ff6daffe3541effea96bedb30d5cbd61ce7d94ac5f00b9f7036`) containing the same 16 printable corrected cards; it is absent from the receipt inventory.
3. The rulebook-update page says the changes affect the first printing and gives the identifying box code `LFCACD30`. The audited 2024 PDF already contains the corrected Rest, Travel, Refresh, Injury, Manifestation, Conduit, and reward-swap text. Likewise, the campaign-guide landing page says the living guide has integrated errata. A corrected-current scope must not double-count integrated historical rulebook/campaign-guide errata as a separate governing layer; a first-printing scope must explicitly include and classify them. “First versus corrected remains unresolved” is too broad for the exact digital rulebook actually cited.
4. The FAQ is already completely retrievable in the recorded 38,012-byte receipt: 11 sections and 33 question/answer entries. Calling that group incomplete because every answer was not transformed mixes source acquisition with semantic extraction. The FAQ also contains later-product concepts (for example moment cards), so Bathcat must classify core/Lure applicability rather than count the whole mixed page blindly.

These are researcher-fixable defects, not external residuals. The Lure category itself reproduces at HTTP 200 and officially reports 96 items; its linked item tree is public. The 22 glossary categories/148 leaves, 33 FAQ answers, 16 card-errata pages, 35 Lure errata pages, rulebook update, and printable card-errata PDF are all publicly retrievable. Only the complete authoritative distinct-card identity/rules-text corpus remains a plausible external gap after these repairs.

**Exact repair required.** On the same blocked draft PR, Bathcat must:

- choose and state one edition boundary: current corrected English digital/core-Lure rules, or first-printing physical core identified by the official barcode code; classify update applicability accordingly;
- inventory and inspect the 96 Lure items, classify all 148 glossary leaves and all 33 FAQ Q&As for core/Lure applicability, and record item-level denominators rather than the 22-letter navigation count;
- record the 16 card-errata pages plus the official printable errata PDF, exclude the two LoA mission cards from a core/Lure count, and classify each remaining update by affected printing;
- recompute the governing-source denominator after removing integrated/historical double counting, then update `manifest.json`, `evidence.json`, `research-report.md`, and the PR body consistently; keep physical-card arithmetic at 540 and distinct factual coverage `UNKNOWN` unless an authoritative identity/text denominator is actually acquired;
- preserve `blocked`, no canonical staging, no approval, no promotion, and request T only for the residual authoritative full card corpus or a product-scope ruling—not for public pages Bathcat can retrieve.

**Risk record.** Assumption: the six named groups are distinct and complete for one English core/Lure edition. Failure: mixed expansion and first-printing material makes `1/6` look reproducible while measuring the wrong corpus. Evidence: the live official inventories and corrected PDF findings above. Cheapest test: classify every linked leaf/update by product and printing, then deduplicate integrated errata before recounting. Mitigation: perform the exact repair list and submit a new immutable head for a wholly fresh audit. Abort condition: stop any approval/promotion if any denominator row remains unclassified or the live head/CI drifts.

**CI and disposition.** Actions run `30648467288`, job `91215627143`, is SUCCESS at the audited head; substantive provenance/intake/OKF/visual/write-guard steps ran successfully (31 tests passed, 1 skipped; intake clean; 2,611 OKF files clean and index fresh). CI proves structure, not the source-scope semantics above. At comment time the PR is OPEN + DRAFT + CLEAN/MERGEABLE, with zero reviews/approvals and no prior comments. It must remain open and draft. Auditor repository files modified: **none**. Approval/promotion/merge: **not performed and forbidden on this head**.

Bathcat repair handoff — **BLOCKED / DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE**

- Audit binding repaired: `8ffca761866cf0e739b272177ff76bca748324d6` → `acb4825d2f3d996dc3375f380b1554dd3b57171c` over unchanged base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`.
- Edition fixed to current corrected English digital core + Lure; first-print `LFCACD30` is comparison only, and integrated rulebook/Lure errata are deduplicated.
- Item inventories closed: 96 Lure items; 22 glossary categories / 148 unique leaves (126 core/Lure, 5 mixed, 6 Legacy, 3 Stewards, 3 Moments, 5 other); 33 FAQ Q&As (31 target, 1 mixed target, 1 Moments-only); 16 card updates (14 target, 2 LoA excluded); 35 integrated Lure updates; first-print rulebook update; and the exact two-page 1,328,433-byte printable errata PDF (`395142fb44dc5ff6daffe3541effea96bedb30d5cbd61ce7d94ac5f00b9f7036`). Every public item row has a machine receipt and classification in `source-inventory.json`.
- Deduplicated bounded public target ledger: `1 + 96 + 131 + 32 + 14 = 274`. Total governing coverage remains `UNKNOWN` (`known_total: null`, `percent: null`) because authoritative complete distinct card identity/rules text remains unavailable.
- Preserved: physical arithmetic 540; factual distinct coverage UNKNOWN; four visual receipts; no rating/weight; no canonical tree, approval, promotion, ready transition, or merge.
- Repair commit changed five files: `TELEMETRY.md`, manifest, evidence, research report, and new item-level `source-inventory.json`. Full PR remains those five paths over base.
- Gates: item ledger clean; focused intake clean; 2,611 OKF files clean/index fresh; local complete suite 37 total / 36 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail; committed-head diff-aware intake clean; diffcheck clean; exact-head CI SUCCESS in run https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/actions/runs/30664777091.
- Residual request to T only: an authoritative complete current corrected English core-plus-Lure distinct-card identity/rules-text inventory, if one exists outside the public resources surface.

Receiver: wholly fresh Mennonite audit bound to `acb4825d2f3d996dc3375f380b1554dd3b57171c`, then fresh Judge oversight. This handoff is not approval or readiness.

REVISE

**Audit binding and state.** I audited PR #21 read-only at repaired head `acb4825d2f3d996dc3375f380b1554dd3b57171c` over base `e0e47b2f7593f5ee34c25c5695be9b6bed172afd`. Local HEAD, upstream, remote branch, freshly fetched `refs/pull/21/head`, and live `headRefOid` matched; the PR is OPEN + DRAFT + MERGEABLE/CLEAN, with zero reviews/approvals. The full base-to-head diff is exactly two commits and five paths (4,976 insertions): `TELEMETRY.md`, manifest, evidence, report, and the 4,357-line source inventory. `git diff --check` is clean; no `canonical/`, `approval.json`, rejection, promotion, ready transition, or corpus-game path exists.

**Independent acquisition and denominator reproduction.** I read all 4,357 inventory lines and re-fetched 326 unique official item/index URLs (328 receipt rows) with a browser user agent: 326/326 returned successfully and reproduced every recorded final URL, status, media type, byte length, and SHA-256. The official category pages bind all 96 Lure rows, all 16 card-update rows, and all 35 Lure-update rows. The FAQ currently exposes 11 headings (the Delightful Rule plus ten Q&A sections); all 33 stored questions occur exactly and have 33 unique question hashes. The two-page errata PDF reproduces exactly at 1,328,433 bytes and SHA-256 `395142fb44dc5ff6daffe3541effea96bedb30d5cbd61ce7d94ac5f00b9f7036`. The 48-page 2024 rulebook reproduces exactly at 21,019,564 bytes and SHA-256 `7738ec6fd2dab30baa53cebc461e179746442650d1f0d12537f481495b7dfc69`; the first-print update names `LFCACD30`, and the current PDF contains the corrected Rest/Travel/Refresh/Injury/Manifestation/Conduit/reward-swap rules. The living-guide update page expressly says its 35 errata entries are integrated, so excluding those 35 and the first-print rulebook update from the corrected-current ledger is sound.

**The 148-leaf discrepancy is resolved, not accepted blindly.** Restricting each alphabetical category page to same-letter `/docs/rules_glossary/<LETTER>/<leaf>` links yields exactly `A14 B2 C15 D9 E8 F6 G4 H2 I4 K1 L4 M9 N1 O2 P19 R12 S19 T10 U3 V1 W2 Y1 = 148`, and that 148-URL set equals the packet set byte-for-byte. The prior sequence totals 169 because a broad category-page link count also captures the preceding category's final-leaf navigation link on every B-through-Y page: direct count +1 for 21 categories, while A has no preceding glossary leaf. Thus `148` is the correct unique-leaf denominator.

**Bathcat-fixable defect — the 148 URLs are complete, but product applicability is not.** The packet's `126 core/Lure + 5 mixed + 6 Legacy + 3 Stewards + 3 Moments + 5 other = 148` classification is false. The official expansion leaves identify later-only concepts that `source-inventory.json` labels `core_lure` or target-applicable:

- `Dangerous (Keyword)` (`source-inventory.json:1931-1941`), `Disabled Thresholds` (`1996-2006`), `Spirit (Keyword)` (`3140-3150`), and `Untraversable (Keyword)` (`3374-3384`) are explicitly listed as additional/new concepts by Legacy of the Ancestors and/or Shadow of the Storm, not core/Lure.
- `Spirit Speaker (Specialty)` (`3153-3163`) and `Talespinner (Background)` (`3231-3241`) are explicitly described by the Stewards of the Valley expansion leaf as entirely new Stewards sets, not core/Lure.
- `Group Tests` (`2269-2279`) is explicitly a new concept of Moments on the Path and Moments in the Valley; its current `mixed` classification wrongly adds it to the target denominator.
- `Expansions` (`2126-2136`) is only a catalogue of the excluded later products, not an operative core/Lure rule, so it is not target-applicable mixed.
- `Keywords` (`2360-2370`) is genuinely mixed, not `core_lure`: its live body includes later-only Aspiration, Dangerous, Deployed, Illumination, Mycelial, Spirit, and Untraversable keywords.
- Bucket labels are also wrong for excluded rows: `Deployed` is shared by Legacy and Stewards, while `Spiritspeaking` belongs to Stewards; neither supports the published three-row Stewards/five-row-other split.

Applying the official expansion-leaf relationships gives a reproducible disposition of `119 core/Lure + 4 target/later mixed + 6 Legacy-only + 5 Stewards-only + 4 Moments-only + 4 other-Valley-only + 1 later-product index + 5 cross-later-only = 148`: **123 target-applicable and 25 excluded**, not 131/17. Therefore the bounded public ledger is `1 + 96 + 123 + 32 + 14 = 266`, not 274. This changes `source-inventory.json`, the evidence summary/hash, `research-report.md`, `manifest.json`, and the live PR body. The complete distinct-card/rules-text denominator still remains unavailable, so `rules.known_total` and `rules.percent` must remain `null`; physical-card arithmetic remains `278 + 160 = 438`, `37 + 24 + 4 + 17 + 4 + 4 + 12 = 102`, and `438 + 102 = 540`, with distinct factual coverage UNKNOWN.

**Other checks.** The current report has 13 Claim/Source/Evidence/Confidence triplets (the repaired head expanded the prior eight); all 13 are structurally complete and all referenced source IDs are declared. Both independent reviews still expose the cited reception meaning despite dynamic wrapper-byte drift. All four 604-pixel-wide visual locators remain meaningful and distinct (card ecosystem, Valley map, ranger area, populated table); three JPEG encodings drifted and one reproduced exactly, without semantic drift or canonical copying. No rating/rank/weight/complexity assertion is made. Inventory receipts are machine-complete and retain only titles, hashes, URLs, questions, and concise classification bases rather than mirrored source text.

**CI and exact repair.** Actions run `30664777091`, job `91269081398`, is SUCCESS at this exact head; substantive intake/provenance, diff-aware intake, OKF, visual, and write-guard steps ran (37 tests total: 36 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed; 2,611 OKF files clean and index fresh). CI proves structure, not the product-classification defect above. Repair the same blocked draft PR by correcting every listed classification and basis, recomputing all classification summaries and the bounded ledger to 266, updating every stale 131/274 assertion in packet and body, regenerating the inventory receipt/hash and required telemetry, and obtaining fresh exact-head CI and a wholly fresh Mennonite audit.

**Risk record.** Assumption: a glossary leaf with no product marker in its own article is core/Lure. Failure: later-only generic rules are counted as target authority, falsely closing eight rows and inflating 123 to 131. Evidence: the official Legacy, Stewards, Moments, and Shadow expansion leaves explicitly enumerate those concepts and sets. Cheapest test: join every glossary leaf against the official expansion pages before target inclusion. Mitigation: perform the exact reclassification and recount above. Abort condition: no acceptance, approval, promotion, ready transition, or merge while any row is misclassified or the exact head/CI drifts.

**Disposition.** This remains a blocked open-gap packet. Auditor repository files modified: **none**. Approval, promotion, ready-state change, and merge: **not performed and forbidden**. Receiver after repair: wholly fresh Mennonite, then Judge oversight.

Superseded by issue-based blocked-intake tracking in #23. This report PR is closed without merge. Its branch and commit history are preserved as evidence; any future PR must begin only after the issue's readiness criteria are satisfied.
